description: This is a time-tracking website clone that we made during the construct week at Masai School. You can put your daily tasks to do and also you can track your workouts on the website.

paragraphs: The TrackingTime website has the following pages and the order of flow is also the same.
features: It was completed within 5 days. We created a good responsive UI. So, you can use this website through phone and tablet also.
In navbar there is one section for the features. On hovering over that you can find one dropdown menu for the features. It has list of features which our website provides.
In our clone not all the features are working but we several features are in work. You can click any of the feature in that dropdown menu and you can find the related information about that feature.
You can find their images for it. and you can also find another image for that product by just hover on it. It is applicable on all the product cards on the website.
It has Time Tracker ,Project Management , Online Timesheet ,Time cards , Attendance tracking pages in that. Time reporting is not available as for now.
